afterSign.text: The fish have kept time since practice moved here. Study them?
afterSign.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR FUNDS STUDY OF FISH IN FOUR-FOUR TIME
clippings.refuse: STUDY SHELVED; FISH STILL KEEPING TIME

afterRefuse.text: Hear the band's piece for you, 'Further Study'. Mostly rests.
afterRefuse.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR APPLAUDS DURING THE RESTS
clippings.refuse: 'FURTHER STUDY' PLAYED TO AN EMPTY CHAIR

afterSign.text: A loud Monday for the band, to level out your silent Sunday.
afterSign.subject: ceremonies

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR SPENDS LOUD MONDAY IN A CUPBOARD
clippings.refuse: LOUD MONDAY MOVED TO A QUIETER DATE

afterRefuse.text: Then sit by the canal with us and say nothing. Rodney is worried.
afterRefuse.subject: ceremonies

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR SILENT FOR AN HOUR; AIDES CONCERNED
clippings.refuse: ANGLERS SIT IN SILENCE, AS USUAL, WITHOUT GOVERNOR

afterSign.text: The bench has floated 2 locks, to where growers water. Anchor it?
afterSign.subject: inventions

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR'S ANCHOR HOLDS BENCH IN THE WRONG PLACE
clippings.refuse: FLOATING BENCH CONTINUES ITS TOUR OF THE PROVINCE

afterRefuse.text: Then survey where the fish prefer to sit. Band practice to pause.
afterRefuse.subject: inventions

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR FUNDS FISH SEATING SURVEY; FISH UNAVAILABLE
clippings.refuse: FISH LEFT TO SIT WHERE THEY LIKE

afterSign.text: Rodney proposes pressing your one bar as a record. Both sides.
afterSign.subject: vanity

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR'S ONE BAR RELEASED; REVIEWS BRIEF
clippings.refuse: ONE BAR REMAINS ONE BAR

afterRefuse.text: The band kept your bar. Conduct half of it? Less to go wrong.
afterRefuse.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR CONDUCTS HALF A BAR; BAND FINISHES IT
clippings.refuse: BAR STILL UNCONDUCTED; BAND PLAYS IT ANYWAY

afterSign.text: The shelter works. Now each cornet wants one, by the canal.
afterSign.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR CUTS RIBBON ON SHELTER FOR ONE CORNET
clippings.refuse: CORNETS SHARE A SHELTER; NOBODY SPEAKS

afterRefuse.text: The tuba asks to use shop doorways. It rattles only 1 pane in 3.
afterRefuse.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: TUBA IN THE DOORWAYS; WINDOWS ON EDGE
clippings.refuse: TUBA PRACTISES AT HOME; HOME RATTLES

afterSign.text: Open the notebook's shelter, standing just behind the notebook.
afterSign.subject: buses

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR UPSTAGED BY NOTEBOOK AT OPENING
clippings.refuse: NOTEBOOK OPENS OWN SHELTER; SPEECH BRIEF

afterRefuse.text: We will pay, in triplicate, to name the shops' bench after our founder's pencil.
afterRefuse.subject: buses

clippings.sign: BENCH NAMED AFTER PENCIL; GOVERNOR SITS ON IT
clippings.refuse: PENCIL GOES UNHONOURED; SOCIETY SHARPENS IT

afterSign.text: Till's Teas would pay to put THE GOVERNOR SIPPED HERE at bus stops.
afterSign.subject: signage

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR'S SIP NOW AT EVERY STOP; BUSES MISSED
clippings.refuse: SIP PHOTOGRAPH KEPT IN THE TEA ROOM, BY THE SUGAR

afterRefuse.text: No sip? Then gaze at our tea from the pavement. Spotters, step back.
afterRefuse.subject: portraits

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR GAZES AT TEA; TEA UNMOVED
clippings.refuse: TEA ROOM OPENS WITHOUT GOVERNOR; TEA SERVED ANYWAY

afterSign.text: Enter the pumpkin's glasshouse as a shop window? It is mostly window.
afterSign.subject: vegetable-shows

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR JUDGES SHOP WINDOWS; PICKS A PUMPKIN
clippings.refuse: PUMPKIN WATCHES WINDOW PRIZE FROM ITS GLASSHOUSE

afterRefuse.text: No glasshouse, so the pumpkin lives under a shop's cake cover. Unveil it?
afterRefuse.subject: vegetable-shows

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR LIFTS COVER; PUMPKIN SAYS NOTHING
clippings.refuse: PUMPKIN STAYS UNDER COVER, AS DOES THE MATTER

afterSign.text: May the show's scales stay on the towpath? They have settled in.
afterSign.subject: vegetable-shows

clippings.sign: TOWPATH SCALES NOW PERMANENT; ANGLERS WEIGH THE QUIET
clippings.refuse: SCALES LEAVE TOWPATH; TOWPATH LIGHTER

afterRefuse.text: A committee to find a second towpath. It has found the first one 6 times.
afterRefuse.subject: vegetable-shows

clippings.sign: COMMITTEE STILL SEARCHING FOR A SECOND TOWPATH
clippings.refuse: SEARCH CALLED OFF; ONE TOWPATH DEEMED PLENTY

afterSign.text: Buses at the bandstand stop wait for each tune to end. Slower tunes?
afterSign.subject: buses

clippings.sign: BAND SLOWS DOWN; 7:02 NOW LEAVES AT 7:40
clippings.refuse: BAND KEEPS TEMPO; BUS LEAVES MID-CHORUS

afterRefuse.text: No stop, then. A bench by the bandstand for spotters? Facing the road.
afterRefuse.subject: buses

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR OPENS BENCH; BAND PLAYS TO ITS BACK
clippings.refuse: SPOTTERS STAND TO WATCH BUSES NOT STOP

afterSign.text: Rodney proposes a float with your face on it, marked STILL AFLOAT.
afterSign.subject: vanity

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR'S FACE BOBS ON CANAL; ANGLERS LOOK AWAY
clippings.refuse: GOVERNOR'S FACE FLOAT FILED FOR FURTHER STUDY

afterRefuse.text: Not hold the float? Then point at it, gently, for the camera.
afterRefuse.subject: ceremonies

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR POINTS AT FLOAT; FLOAT HOLDS STILL
clippings.refuse: FLOAT PHOTOGRAPHED ALONE; LOOKS DIGNIFIED

afterSign.text: The band will pay to list its tuning up, too. It runs all evening.
afterSign.subject: bandstands

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR ATTENDS TUNING UP; LEAVES BEFORE THE MUSIC
clippings.refuse: TUNING UP REMAINS PRIVATE; PRACTICE STILL PUBLIC

afterRefuse.text: Practice is not an event, then. Cut a ribbon at it, so that it is?
afterRefuse.subject: ribbons

clippings.sign: GOVERNOR CUTS RIBBON ON BAND PRACTICE; BAND STOPS TO WATCH
clippings.refuse: PRACTICE GOES AHEAD UNOPENED
